name: Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochPrivacyVariance_fullBatch_eq_base_sq
typeText:
∀ (epoch : ℕ) (epoch_pos : 0 < epoch) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ) (sensitivity_pos : 0 < sensitivity)
  (epsilon_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilon) (delta_pos : 0 < delta) (delta_lt_one : delta < 1),
  Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochPrivacyVarianceOfStddev (Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint.fullBatch epoch epoch_pos)
      ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedStddev (Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint.fullBatch epoch epoch_pos) sensitivity
          epsilon delta) =
    Mf.DP.fullBatchGaussianBaseStddev sensitivity epsilon delta sensitivity_pos epsilon_nonneg delta_pos delta_lt_one ^
      2

name: Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedPrivacyVariance_gt_fullBatch_of_exactCriticalSignalSquareCondition
typeText:
∀ (point : Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ),
  point.epoch < point.horizon →
    ∀ (hSensitivity : 0 < sensitivity) (hEpsilon : 0 < epsilon) (hDeltaPos : 0 < delta) (hDeltaLtOne : delta < 1),
      Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochExactCriticalSignalSquareCondition point epsilon
          (Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochStandardizedSignal sensitivity
            ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochFullBatchCalibratedRunVariance sensitivity epsilon delta hSensitivity ⋯ hDeltaPos
                hDeltaLtOne)) →
        ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochFullBatchCalibratedRunVariance sensitivity epsilon delta hSensitivity ⋯ hDeltaPos
              hDeltaLtOne) <
          Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedPrivacyVariance point sensitivity epsilon delta

name: Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochTotalAverageVariance_fullBatch_lt_of_exactCriticalSignalSquareCondition
typeText:
∀ (point : Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint) (sensitivity epsilon delta energy : ℝ),
  point.epoch < point.horizon →
    ∀ (hSensitivity : 0 < sensitivity) (hEpsilon : 0 < epsilon) (hDeltaPos : 0 < delta) (hDeltaLtOne : delta < 1),
      0 ≤ energy →
        Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochExactCriticalSignalSquareCondition point epsilon
            (Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochStandardizedSignal sensitivity
              ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochFullBatchCalibratedRunVariance sensitivity epsilon delta hSensitivity ⋯ hDeltaPos
                  hDeltaLtOne)) →
          Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochTotalAverageVariance (Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint.fullBatch point.epoch ⋯) sensitivity
              epsilon delta energy <
            Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochTotalAverageVariance point sensitivity epsilon delta energy

name: Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedPrivacyVariance_gt_fullBatch_of_epochUniformSignal
typeText:
∀ (point : Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ),
  point.epoch < point.horizon →
    ∀ (hSensitivity : 0 < sensitivity) (hEpsilon : 0 < epsilon) (hDeltaPos : 0 < delta) (hDeltaLtOne : delta < 1),
      Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochStandardizedSignal sensitivity
              ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochFullBatchCalibratedRunVariance sensitivity epsilon delta hSensitivity ⋯ hDeltaPos
                  hDeltaLtOne) ^
            2 ≤
          Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochEpochUniformSignalSquareFactor point.epoch * epsilon →
        ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochFullBatchCalibratedRunVariance sensitivity epsilon delta hSensitivity ⋯ hDeltaPos
              hDeltaLtOne) <
          Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedPrivacyVariance point sensitivity epsilon delta

name: Mf.DP.tendsto_poissonFixedEpochCalibratedStddev_smallRate_ratio_one
typeText:
∀ (epoch : ℕ) (epoch_pos : 0 < epoch) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ),
  0 < sensitivity →
    0 ≤ epsilon →
      0 < delta →
        delta < 1 - Real.exp (-↑epoch) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun extra =>
              ↑(Mf.DP.poissonFixedEpochCalibratedStddev (Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint.ofExtra epoch epoch_pos extra)
                      sensitivity epsilon delta) *
                  √(2 * Real.log (1 / ↑(Mf.DP.PoissonFixedEpochPoint.ofExtra epoch epoch_pos extra).samplingRate)) /
                sensitivity)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

name: Mf.DP.tendsto_poissonFixedEpochPrivacyVariance_div_leadingTerm_one
typeText:

name: Mf.DP.tendsto_sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev_finiteOffset
typeText:
∀ (schedule : Mf.DP.FixedParticipationSchedule) (sensitivity : ℝ) (noiseStddev : ℕ → NNReal) (offset epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < sensitivity →
    0 ≤ epsilon →
      (∀ᶠ (horizon : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < noiseStddev horizon) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun horizon => sensitivity / ↑(noiseStddev horizon) - Mf.DP.gaussianCriticalScale horizon)
            Filter.atTop (nhds offset) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun horizon =>
              Mf.DP.sampledGaussianProductProfileStddev horizon (schedule.samplingRate horizon) ⋯ sensitivity
                (noiseStddev horizon) epsilon)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - Real.exp (-↑schedule.participationBudget * Mf.DP.stdNormalCDFReal offset))))

name: Mf.DP.tendsto_fixedParticipationCalibratedStddev_offset
typeText:
∀ (schedule : Mf.DP.FixedParticipationSchedule) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ),
  0 < sensitivity →
    0 ≤ epsilon →
      0 < delta →
        delta < 1 - Real.exp (-↑schedule.participationBudget) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun horizon =>
              sensitivity / ↑(Mf.DP.fixedParticipationCalibratedStddev schedule sensitivity epsilon delta horizon) -
                Mf.DP.gaussianCriticalScale horizon)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (Mf.DP.fixedParticipationTargetOffset (↑schedule.participationBudget) delta))

name: Mf.DP.tendsto_cappedFixedParticipationCalibratedStddev_smallRate_ratio_one
typeText:
∀ (participationBudget : NNReal) (hBudget : 0 < participationBudget) (sensitivity epsilon delta : ℝ),
  0 < sensitivity →
    0 ≤ epsilon →
      0 < delta →
        delta < 1 - Real.exp (-↑participationBudget) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun horizon =>
              ↑(Mf.DP.fixedParticipationCalibratedStddev
                      (Mf.DP.cappedFixedParticipationSchedule participationBudget hBudget) sensitivity epsilon delta
                      horizon) *
                  √(2 * Real.log (1 / ↑(Mf.DP.cappedParticipationRate participationBudget horizon))) /
                sensitivity)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
